caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object rendered in a monochromatic style, with shades of grey and black lines on a light beige background. The object consists of two main components joined at a central point. On the left, there is an oval or teardrop-shaped loop with a narrow band attached at the end, accented with small dots or studs. This loop connects to a more angular, complex structure on the right, featuring several straight and curved segments with a decorative zigzag pattern on one edge. The right section terminates with two rounded ends, each containing a circular loop, and there is an additional ring in the central part of the device. The entire composition is drawn with clear outlines and a few shadowed sections to suggest dimensionality, placed slightly off-center toward the bottom right of the otherwise plain page.
title: Roller Bit
